lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.en: How's Jimmy today?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Williams
lines.en: Better. Thank you, doctor.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.en: Can I see him please, Mrs. Williams?
lines.zh: 我可以看看他吗，威廉斯夫人？

lines.speaker: Mrs. Williams
lines.en: Certainly, doctor.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Williams
lines.en: Come upstairs.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.en: You look very well, Jimmy.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.en: You are better now, but you mustn't get up yet.
lines.zh: 你现在好些了，但你还不应该起床。

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.en: You must stay in bed for another two days.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.en: The boy mustn't go to school yet, Mrs. Williams.
lines.zh: 这孩子还不能去上学，威廉斯夫人，

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.en: And he mustn't eat rich food.
lines.zh: 而且不能吃油腻的食物。

lines.speaker: Mrs. Williams
lines.en: Does he have a temperature, doctor?

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.en: No, he doesn't.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Williams
lines.en: Must he stay in bed?

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.en: Yes. He must remain in bed for another two days.
lines.zh: 是的，他还必须卧床两天。

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.en: He can get up for about two hours each day,
lines.zh: 他每天可以起来两个小时，

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.en: but you must keep the room warm.
lines.zh: 但您必须保持房间温暖。

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.en: Where's Mr. Williams this evening?
lines.zh: 威廉斯先生今晚去哪儿了？

lines.speaker: Mrs. Williams
lines.en: He's in bed, doctor.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Williams
lines.en: Can you see him please?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Williams
lines.en: He has a bad cold, too!

drills.en: I mustn't take any aspirins. → Jimmy ___ take any aspirins.
drills.zh: 吉米不应该吃阿斯匹林。

drills.en: I can get up for two hours each day. → Jimmy ___ get up for two hours each day.
drills.zh: 吉米每天可以起来两个小时。

drills.en: I often read in bed. → Jimmy often ___ in bed.
I don't feel ill now. → Jimmy ___ feel ill now.
drills.zh: 吉米现在不觉得难受了。
